description: Authoritative list of every billed deployment and Serverless project with its deployment_type, region and provider. deployment_type 'deployment' means Elastic Cloud Hosted; 'elasticsearch', 'observability' and 'security' mean Serverless. Use this to classify a deployment before giving advice, instead of inferring it from a blank name or from missing utilization data - those are not reliable signals.

configuration.query:
FROM metrics-ess_billing.billing-*
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", @timestamp, NOW()) <= ?days
| EVAL platform = CASE(ess.billing.deployment_type == "deployment", "hosted", "serverless")
| STATS chargeable_units = SUM(ess.billing.total_ecu), skus = COUNT_DISTINCT(ess.billing.sku)
    BY deployment_id = ess.billing.deployment_id, deployment_name = ess.billing.deployment_name, deployment_type = ess.billing.deployment_type, platform, region = cloud.region
| SORT chargeable_units DESC
| LIMIT 50
